description: This file contains the definition of the 'Online' model class within the Opencart admin reporting namespace. It provides methods to retrieve online customer data and count online customers, likely for reporting and analytics purposes.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: A model class used for fetching online customer information and related statistics within the OpenCart admin reporting module.

methods.name: getOnline
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently online customers based on filter criteria such as IP address and customer name, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getTotalOnline
methods.description: Returns the total count of online customers matching filter criteria.
